biggest_catch: Miss any one of the three — no referral link at signup, no $200+ direct deposit within 45 days, no physical card activation within 14 days of the deposit — and the $100 disappears; and the referrer's own bonus amount is not fixed.
catches: No referral link used at signup = no bonus, and it cannot be added later.
The $200+ deposit must be a single qualifying direct deposit within 45 days of opening — payroll/gig/government ACH; bank transfers, PayPal/Venmo, and cash loads do not count.
You must activate the physical Chime Visa Debit Card within 14 calendar days of that qualifying deposit.
The referrer's bonus amount varies based on their active offer — it is not a fixed $100 for them.
Maximum 10 successful referral rewards per calendar year.
Bonus is taxable income (reported on 1099-INT for new members; 1099-MISC for referrers at $600+).

steps: Get a current Chime member's referral link — the bonus only works if you sign up through it; it cannot be added later.
Tap the referral link, download the Chime app (search 'Chime – Mobile Banking' in the App Store or Google Play, developer Chime), and open a Chime Checking Account.
Complete identity verification (name, address, Social Security number) and finish signup through the referral link.
When your physical Chime Visa Debit Card arrives in the mail, keep it — you will need to activate it.
Set up a qualifying direct deposit: in the Chime app find your account and routing numbers, and give them to your employer/payroll or gig platform for a deposit of $200 or more.
Make sure that $200+ deposit lands within 45 days of opening the account.
Activate your physical card in the app within 14 calendar days of that deposit landing. The $100 bonus is paid once all three conditions are met.
timing: Not stated on the official page; paid after all three qualifying conditions are complete.
